Not what it used to be
Apr 2018 • Family
I reviewed this restaurant in the past and really enjoyed it. However it seems to be slipping, more than likely due to its proximity to the new senses underground market. Went in and ordered a beer and was told we just ran out. So I had another brand no big deal. Went back that evening for dinner to have the Aussie beef, guess what, we just ran out of that also. Funny when they are not doing any business. Spent 30 years working in the industry and know the signs of a slow death and it seems Sandos isn’t long for this world. So sad. Also service was pathetic as server was more interested with videos on her phone than taking good care of her guests. Wish I could give it a better review but can not.

Excellent choice for dinner
Jan 2017 • Friends
We decided to try this small place (only few tables) because of all the good reviews it had received. And we weren't disappointed.

Staff was extremely friendly and service was efficient. We ordered chicken curry with rice and it was delicious! Spicy but not too spicy. You can choose between international "basic" food and vietnamese classics.

And a huge plus was the location. It wasn't located on the busy Bui Vien street but on more quiet alley next to it: no loud base music, pushy venders or busy traffic. A bit calmer atmosphere was nice for a change. Still you are only few steps away from the Bui Vien and its services.

What a gem! Perfect!
Dec 2016 • Couples
Me and my partner have been backpacking around Asia for a little over 5 weeks now and have been craving some "normal" food and everywhere we have tried to satisfy our cravings have let us down... until now!

We passed by and thought we would give it a go - it was delicious! I had the chicken, avocado and cheese baguette with chips, my partner the jacket potatoes with coleslaw and cheese and we shared the Vietnamese mixed veg and I don't have one bad word to say about anything -

The vegetables were fresh, crunchy and was a whole plate full (compared to the little dishes of veg we have been getting) I could have eaten 4 more it was so nice! 

My baguette was fresh and crunchy with fresh avocado and a lovely seasoning on the chicken - the chips were cooked perfectly! 

The whole meal was just a pleasure and hit the spot on our cravings, and all huge portions for a very VERY reasonable price! They have happy hour on too every night so we got 2 x tiger beers for 40k so that was the topping on a great dinner! Highway recommended if you're looking for a good fill that's easy on the pocket! 😘

We're going back tomorrow for lunch....
